note.question: What role does setting planned leadtimes play in customer-order-driven assembly systems?
note.overview: This paper studies an assembly system with a number of parallel multistage processes feeding a multistage final assembly process. Each stage has a stochastic throughput time. We assume that the system is controlled by planned leadtimes at each stage.
